messages:
jules: Heads-up: canary in eu-west-2 showing memory OOMs right after the night merge window. seeing 1-2 pods crashlooping.

omar: I think two PRs landed together: my PR bumped chart to v3.2.0 (sidecar config) and sel's PR changed `values.resources.requests.memory` from 256Mi -> 64Mi.

sel: yikes that was supposed to be 256 -> 512 for cost reasons, not down to 64. fixed locally but maybe bad rebase.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-10-01T22:40:03Z by jules/merged. Canary fraction 10% -> 30%. Diff highlights: `chart.version: 3.1.8 -> 3.2.0`, `values.resources.requests.memory: 256Mi -> 64Mi`. Observed: OOMKilled on payments-worker x3 in 5m.

jules: options: (A) full rollback to previous release (loses unrelated chart bump sidecar tuning), (B) hotpatch to restore memory requests to 256Mi in values and restart, (C) pin chart and apply resources fix separately. Thoughts?

omar: the sidecar change is important for telemetry; prefer hotpatch to restore memory request only. quick revert in values is fastest.

sel: on it, will open hotfix PR to set memory back to 256Mi and add a helm lint rule to catch suspicious decreases >50%. PR#7001.

ci-bot: PR#7001 triggered CI: lint, unit, helm-lint. ETA ~4m.

jules: hold canary and pause auto-rollback for 15m while we patch. deploy-bot, pause please and ping eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Pausing auto-rollback for deploy 2025-10-01T22:40:03Z for 15 minutes per request from jules. Notifying #eng-oncall.

sel: CI green, merging PR#7001. Applying hotpatch: `kubectl -n payments set resources deployment/payments-worker --requests=memory=256Mi` (manual annot)

omar: patch applied. pods rolling, new pods coming up with higher memory request.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied at 22:45 UTC. Canary fraction pinned at 5% for 5m. Health checks show no further OOMs.

jules: metrics look stable, memory usage within expected headroom. Good catch.

omar: follow-ups: 1) add helm-lint check for >50% decrease in resource requests; 2) preflight detect multi-PR merges touching chart + values in same release and require a manual review. Filing TKT-558.

sel: also adding a changelog note: "Reverted accidental low memory request that caused OOMs during canary; retained chart sidecar bump."

jules: unpause auto-rollback and resume normal policies. deploy-bot, clear the pause.

deploy-bot: Resuming auto-rollback and clearing pause for deploy 2025-10-01T22:40:03Z.

omar: thanks team. I'll ensure the sidecar bump gets smoke-tested separately before next batch merge. :thumbsup:
